decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 
Subject to appropriate safeguarding conditions it is considered that this application for the insertion of two-rooflights at 48 Hamilton Road would not harm the appearance the existing building or the character of the surrounding Conservation Area` and would protect neighbours' living conditions. The proposal is considered to be in accordance with Policies ENV B.1.1 (New Development), ENV-B.2.2 (Conservation Areas) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) within the Unitary Development Plan (December 2003), and the relevant provisions of the Residential Extension Guidelines (July 2002).
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces surrounding the rooflights hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
description: Installation of 2 roof lights in the rear roof slope of the house
